comment: Intentional protocol changes, each keyed by the name check_protocol.py prints and valued with the reason and the GOAT change that adopts it. Keep empty unless GOAT has adopted the change.

tools.get_browser_state: cua-driver#134 adds optional origin_scope (array of origins) to this browser tool's inputSchema; the schema already allowed additional properties, so the checker cannot prove the addition is additive. The argument is optional for driver-owned and embedded browsers and required on every page-tool call into a person's existing profile (rust/crates/cua-driver-core/src/browser/origin_scope.rs, unchanged by the 0.62 sync). GOAT grants this tool only conditionally: goat-si/goat dev packages/shared/src/cuaDriverManifest.ts lists it in CUA_DRIVER_CLAIM_TOOLS, which cuaDriverCapabilityManifest adds to allow.tools only when browserClaimsSupported is true and the manifest carries browser existing_profiles and origins; otherwise it stays in CUA_DRIVER_EXCLUDED_TOOLS. GOAT is compatible on that path: it enables browser claims only when get_browser_state advertises origin_scope (apps/server/src/cua/ComputerUseLeaseProxyBrowserClaims.ts supportsBrowserClaims), its claim proxy sends origin_scope set to the claim's origins, with the claim's target_id and session, on every claimed browser call (scopeBrowserCall), and the server re-checks that scope at reservation (serverAdmitsBrowserCall). The claim bind also calls it with origin_scope: [origin] (apps/server/src/preview/BrowserClaimBind.ts).

tools.click: Upstream sync (trycua/cua 33a57bb0a, niri adapter) adds maximum: 3 to click's count on Linux and clamps a larger count to a triple click at run time (click_train), because a niri click train is rechecked only once, before its first press, so count: 20 would mean seconds of ungated presses. The tightening only bounds count; every other argument is unchanged. GOAT cannot be broken: its Linux helper sends count 2 for doubleClick (apps/server/src/cua/linuxHelper/linuxActions.ts) and screen-code tab clicks already accept only 1, 2 or 3 (apps/server/src/screenCode/ScreenTargetPrelude.ts); a larger count is clamped, not refused.
tools.page: Upstream sync (trycua/cua b13430e0, #7483) removes the legacy page tool's page actions: the action enum keeps get_text and query_dom and drops execute_javascript, click_element, insert_text, type_keystrokes and enable_javascript_apple_events, with their arguments (javascript, selector, text, cdp_port, target_url_contains, bundle_id, user_has_confirmed_enabling) and the CUA_DRIVER_ENABLE_LEGACY_PAGE_MUTATIONS switch that gated them; a removed action is refused before anything is sent. GOAT cannot be broken: its pinned capability manifest excludes page (packages/shared/src/cuaDriverManifest.ts CUA_DRIVER_EXCLUDED_TOOLS, 'deprecated browser compatibility tool'), so GOAT never calls it, and those actions were already refused unless a daemon operator set the switch.
tools.escalate_session: Upstream sync to cua-driver-rs-v0.62.0 (goat-cu cu/261125-upstream-0.62, step S1: trycua/cua d2fb9e24f #7481, cua-driver-rs 0.48.0) removes the deprecated capture-scope escalation tool together with the picture-in-picture preview. GOAT cannot be broken: its pinned capability manifest excludes escalate_session (packages/shared/src/cuaDriverManifest.ts CUA_DRIVER_EXCLUDED_TOOLS, 'deprecated capture-scope escalation'), so GOAT never calls it; GOAT updates that list when it bumps the pin.

GOAT cannot be broken: its pinned capability manifest excludes get_session_state (packages/shared/src/cuaDriverManifest.ts CUA_DRIVER_EXCLUDED_TOOLS, 'deprecated capture-scope read'), so GOAT never calls it; GOAT updates that list when it bumps the pin.
tools.start_session:outputSchema: Upstream sync to cua-driver-rs-v0.62.0 (goat-cu cu/261125-upstream-0.62, step S1: trycua/cua d2fb9e24f #7481, cua-driver-rs 0.48.0) drops escalation_reason and escalation_detail from start_session's output with the removed escalation flow; every other field is unchanged. GOAT cannot be broken: a read-only search of goat-si/goat finds no reader of escalation_detail, and escalation_reason appears only in GOAT's own unrelated decision routing (apps/server/src/goatclaw/DecisionRouting.ts).
tools.set_config: Upstream sync to cua-driver-rs-v0.62.0 (goat-cu cu/261125-upstream-0.62, step S1: trycua/cua d2fb9e24f #7481, cua-driver-rs 0.48.0) removes the experimental_pip and experimental_pip_geometry keys with the picture-in-picture preview; later steps add cursor.float, cursor.halo, cursor.marks, cursor.rotate and fast_path. GOAT cannot be broken: its pinned capability manifest excludes set_config (packages/shared/src/cuaDriverManifest.ts CUA_DRIVER_EXCLUDED_TOOLS, 'driver configuration belongs to GOAT'), so GOAT never calls it; GOAT updates that list when it bumps the pin.

daemon.contract_version: Upstream sync to cua-driver-rs-v0.62.0 (step S8, cua-driver-rs 0.53.0-0.54.0) moves the daemon contract from 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 with additive fields (display-only observations, optional Windows is_password, recording started_at_unix_ms); later steps add optional custom_actions, nullable z_index and ui_tree_revision. GOAT cannot be broken: a read-only search of goat-si/goat finds no check of the daemon contract_version; GOAT reads the fields it uses by name.
